edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Poor flow-mediated dilation signals impaired nitric-oxide biology and endothelial health, an early step in atherosclerotic risk.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2026 Fuertes-Kenneally meta analysis in Eur J Prev Cardiol, which ties endothelial dysfunction by flow-mediated dilation to cardiovascular disease in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
